title: 矩阵微分：布局约定与基本定义
titleEn: Matrix Calculus: Layout Conventions and Basic Definitions
summary: 用「混合布局」（标量导数按分母/梯度约定、向量对向量按标准雅可比）固定标量对向量、向量对向量、标量对矩阵三种导数的形状，并用全微分与迹把它们统一成同一套识别方法。
summaryEn: Fix the shapes of scalar-by-vector, vector-by-vector and scalar-by-matrix derivatives under the mixed layout (denominator/gradient layout for scalar derivatives, the standard m×n Jacobian for vector-by-vector derivatives), and unify them through the differential and the trace.
definition:
多元微积分里已经会算梯度、雅可比与全微分，但那套语言只覆盖「标量对标量、标量对向量、向量对向量」的情形。一旦自变量本身是矩阵 $X\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$，第一件事不是算，而是**约定形状**——同一个函数在不同文献里可以写成形状完全不同的「导数」。本库全部矩阵微分内容统一采用**混合布局（mixed layout）**：**标量**对向量、标量对矩阵的导数按「分母布局」（谁的变元在分母上，导数的形状就跟着谁走）；**向量对向量**的导数取标准的 $m\times n$ **雅可比矩阵**（行=输出维数；这一支在文献里也称雅可比布局/分子布局）。

三种基本情形。**(i) 标量对向量**：$f:\mathbb{R}^{n}\to\mathbb{R}$ 时 $\partial f/\partial x$ 与 $x$ **同型**（$n\times1$ 列向量），第 $j$ 个分量是 $\partial f/\partial x_{j}$，于是 $df=(\partial f/\partial x)^{\top}dx$。**(ii) 向量对向量**：$y\in\mathbb{R}^{m}$、$x\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$ 时 $\partial y/\partial x$ 是 $m\times n$ 的**雅可比矩阵**，第 $(i,j)$ 元为 $\partial y_{i}/\partial x_{j}$，于是 $dy=(\partial y/\partial x)\,dx$；它的第 $i$ 行恰好是 $\nabla y_{i}$ 的转置。**(iii) 标量对矩阵**：$f:\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}\to\mathbb{R}$ 时 $\partial f/\partial X$ 与 $X$ **同型**（$m\times n$），第 $(i,j)$ 元为 $\partial f/\partial X_{ij}$，于是

$$df=\sum_{i,j}\frac{\partial f}{\partial X_{ij}}\,dX_{ij}=\operatorname{tr}\!\left(\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial X}\right)^{\!\top}dX\right).$$

最后这条恒等式是矩阵微分最常用的**识别工具**：把 $df$ 整理成 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ 的形状，则 $G$ 就是 $\partial f/\partial X$，因为 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)=\sum_{i,j}G_{ij}\,dX_{ij}$。这一个小技巧把「矩阵求导」变成「展开微分 + 凑迹」，几乎不用背公式表。

**布局警告**：不少文献（如 Wikipedia 的引言部分）默认**分子布局（numerator layout）**，把标量对向量的导数写成行向量——与本站的标量约定互为转置；向量对向量的公式则要先看清对方的雅可比是 $m\times n$ 还是 $n\times m$。另注：常用手册《Matrix Cookbook》的**标量**导数条目与本站同形，可直接照用，其向量对向量、矩阵对矩阵条目则需逐条核对取向。引用现成公式之前，先确认它用的是哪套约定，再决定要不要转置。本库的一切矩阵微分结论都按上面的**混合布局**书写。
definitionEn:
Multivariable calculus already gives us gradients, Jacobians and total differentials, but that language only covers scalar and vector arguments. As soon as the variable itself is a matrix $X\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$, the first question is not how to compute, but **how to fix shapes**: the same function is written with completely different “derivative” shapes in different references. All matrix calculus in this library uses a **mixed layout**: the derivative of a **scalar** with respect to a vector or a matrix follows the **denominator layout** (its shape follows the denominator), whereas the derivative of a vector with respect to a vector is the standard $m\times n$ **Jacobian** (rows indexed by the output; also called the Jacobian formulation, or the numerator layout in some sources).

Three basic cases. **(i) Scalar by vector**: for $f:\mathbb{R}^{n}\to\mathbb{R}$, the derivative $\partial f/\partial x$ has the **same shape as x** (an $n\times1$ column vector), with $j$-th entry $\partial f/\partial x_{j}$, so $df=(\partial f/\partial x)^{\top}dx$. **(ii) Vector by vector**: for $y\in\mathbb{R}^{m}$ and $x\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$, $\partial y/\partial x$ is the $m\times n$ **Jacobian** with $(i,j)$ entry $\partial y_{i}/\partial x_{j}$, so $dy=(\partial y/\partial x)\,dx$; its $i$-th row is the transpose of $\nabla y_{i}$. **(iii) Scalar by matrix**: for $f:\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}\to\mathbb{R}$, $\partial f/\partial X$ has the **same shape as X**, with $(i,j)$ entry $\partial f/\partial X_{ij}$, so

$$df=\sum_{i,j}\frac{\partial f}{\partial X_{ij}}\,dX_{ij}=\operatorname{tr}\!\left(\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial X}\right)^{\!\top}dX\right).$$

The last identity is the standard **recognition tool**: rearrange $df$ into the form $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ and read off $G=\partial f/\partial X$, because $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)=\sum_{i,j}G_{ij}\,dX_{ij}$. This single trick turns matrix differentiation into “expand the differential, match the trace” and makes long tables of formulas unnecessary.

**A warning on layout**: many sources (e.g. Wikipedia's introductory sections) default to the **numerator layout**, writing scalar-by-vector derivatives as row vectors — the transpose of our scalar convention; and for vector-by-vector formulas one must first check whether their Jacobian is $m\times n$ or $n\times m$. Note also that the widely used *Matrix Cookbook* matches our **scalar** derivatives directly, while its vector-by-vector and matrix-by-matrix entries should be checked case by case. Before using a published formula, check which convention it follows and transpose if necessary. Everything in this library is written in the **mixed layout** above.

formulas.latex: \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}&\in\mathbb{R}^{n},\qquad \left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)_{j}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x_{j}}\\[2pt]df&=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)^{\top}dx\end{aligned}
formulas.note: 标量对向量：梯度与 x 同型（n 维列向量），全微分就是它与 dx 的内积。
formulas.noteEn: Scalar by vector: the gradient has the same shape as x (an n-vector), and the differential is its inner product with dx.

formulas.latex: \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}&\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n},\qquad \left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}\right)_{ij}=\frac{\partial y_{i}}{\partial x_{j}}\\[2pt]dy&=\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}\,dx\end{aligned}
formulas.note: 向量对向量：得到 m×n 的雅可比矩阵；第 i 行是 ∇yᵢ 的转置，dy 就是矩阵乘向量。
formulas.noteEn: Vector by vector: the m×n Jacobian; its i-th row is the transpose of ∇yᵢ, and dy is a matrix-vector product.

formulas.note: 标量对矩阵：与 X 同型；把 df 凑成 tr(GᵀdX) 时 G 就是 ∂f/∂X（因为 tr(GᵀdX)=Σ Gᵢⱼ dXᵢⱼ）。
formulas.noteEn: Scalar by matrix: same shape as X; once df is written as tr(Gᵀ dX), the matrix G is ∂f/∂X, because tr(Gᵀ dX) = Σ Gᵢⱼ dXᵢⱼ.

formulas.note: 一阶近似就是全微分的重写；误差是高阶小量，这也给出用有限差分检验梯度的办法。
formulas.noteEn: The first-order approximation is just the total differential rewritten; the error is of higher order, which yields the finite-difference check of a gradient.

formulas.latex: \left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)_{\text{分子布局}}=\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)_{\text{分母布局}}^{\top}
formulas.note: 分子布局与分母布局的结果互为转置（标量对向量时前者是行向量）；套公式前先核对约定。
formulas.noteEn: The two layouts give transposes of each other (the numerator layout yields a row vector in the scalar-by-vector case); check the convention before using a formula.

properties: 形状法则：标量对向量的导数与自变量同型（列向量），向量对向量的导数是 m×n 雅可比矩阵，标量对矩阵的导数与矩阵同型；形状对不上，一定是布局搞错或漏了转置。
识别工具：把全微分整理成 tr(GᵀdX) 后，G 就是 ∂f/∂X——这一步只用到 tr(GᵀdX) = Σᵢⱼ Gᵢⱼ dXᵢⱼ。
雅可比矩阵的第 i 行是 ∇yᵢ 的转置，所以向量对向量的导数可以看成「把每个分量的梯度按行摞起来」。
一阶近似 $f(x+dx)\approx f(x)+(\nabla f)^{\top}dx$ 与全微分 $df=(\nabla f)^{\top}dx$ 是同一件事的两种写法，误差为 $o(\|dx\|)$；它同时给出用有限差分检验梯度的办法。
约定警告：本库标量导数按**分母（梯度）布局**；不少文献默认**分子布局**（标量对向量的导数为行向量），两者互为转置；向量对向量的雅可比还需另行核对取向。搬运公式前先确认约定。
propertiesEn: Shape rule: the derivative of a scalar with respect to a vector has the same shape as the vector (a column), a vector-by-vector derivative is an m×n Jacobian, and a scalar-by-matrix derivative has the same shape as the matrix; a shape mismatch always means a wrong layout or a missing transpose.
Recognition tool: once the differential is written as tr(Gᵀ dX), the matrix G is exactly ∂f/∂X, using only tr(Gᵀ dX) = Σᵢⱼ Gᵢⱼ dXᵢⱼ.
The i-th row of ∂y/∂x is the transpose of ∇yᵢ, so a vector-by-vector derivative is simply the gradients of the components stacked as rows.

The first-order approximation $f(x+dx)\approx f(x)+(\nabla f)^{\top}dx$ and the total differential $df=(\nabla f)^{\top}dx$ are two ways of writing the same statement, with error $o(\|dx\|)$; it also supplies the finite-difference test of a gradient.

Convention warning: this library uses the denominator (gradient) layout for scalar derivatives, while many sources default to the numerator layout (scalar-by-vector derivatives as row vectors) — the two are transposes of each other; Jacobians of vector-by-vector derivatives need a separate orientation check. Always verify the convention before importing a formula.

examples.problem: 设 $x=(x_1,\dots,x_n)^{\top}$，$A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$。求 $\partial(x^{\top}x)/\partial x$ 与 $\partial(Ax)/\partial x$，并核对形状。
examples.solution:
**第一问**：$f(x)=x^{\top}x$，展开微分 $df=(dx)^{\top}x+x^{\top}dx=2x^{\top}dx=(2x)^{\top}dx$，故 $\partial(x^{\top}x)/\partial x=2x$，与 $x$ 同型（$n\times1$）✓。数值核对：取 $x=(1,2,3)^{\top}$，则 $f=1+4+9=14$；令 $x+te_1=(1+t,2,3)^{\top}$，得 $f=14+2t+t^2$，一次项系数 $2$ 恰等于 $(2x)_1$ ✓。

**第二问**：$g(x)=Ax$ 的第 $i$ 个分量为 $g_i=\sum_j A_{ij}x_j$，故 $\partial g_i/\partial x_j=A_{ij}$，即 $\partial(Ax)/\partial x=A$，形状 $m\times n$，与 $A$ 一致 ✓。数值核对：取 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{pmatrix}$、$x=(1,1)^{\top}$，则 $Ax=(3,7)^{\top}$；再令 $x+te_2=(1,1+t)^{\top}$，得 $Ax=(3,7)^{\top}+t(2,4)^{\top}$，导向量 $(2,4)^{\top}$ 正是 $A$ 的第二列 ✓。

examples.problem: 用一阶近似检验 $f(x)=x^{\top}x$ 在 $x=(1,2)^{\top}$ 附近的表现。

title: 矩阵微分的运算法则
summary: 把求导变成对恒等式两边取微分：线性、转置、乘积、逆、迹、行列式与 Hadamard 乘积的微分法则，以及「先内后外」的链式流程。
summaryEn: Differentiate identities instead of entries: rules for linearity, transpose, products, inverses, trace, determinant and the Hadamard product, plus the inner-first chain workflow.
definition:
有了形状约定，还要一台**运算引擎**。矩阵微分的做法不是每次从头算偏导，而是对恒等式两边同时取**微分** $d$：把每个矩阵看成单参数族 $X(t)=X_0+tB$ 在 $t=0$ 处的方向导数，$d$ 就是「沿任意方向 $B$ 求导」的线性算子。$d$ 对加法、数乘、转置、迹都很友好，但遇到矩阵乘法时**顺序不能交换**——这是全部易错点的根源（本节法则作用于**微分 $d$** 本身，与布局约定无关；但搬运其他文献的导数/梯度公式时仍需先核对布局约定）。

基本法则：$d(X+Y)=dX+dY$、$d(kX)=k\,dX$、$d(X^{\top})=(dX)^{\top}$；乘积法则 $d(XY)=(dX)Y+X(dY)$（两个因子的左右位置固定）；逆的微分 $d(X^{-1})=-X^{-1}(dX)X^{-1}$（负号加三个因子把 $dX$ 夹在中间，要求 $X$ 可逆）；Hadamard 乘积 $d(X\odot Y)=(dX)\odot Y+X\odot(dY)$ 逐元素成立。标量导数沿用全批统一约定（**分母/梯度布局**）：$\partial f/\partial X$ 与 $X$ 同型，$df=\operatorname{tr}((\partial f/\partial X)^{\top}dX)$。

标量函数最常用的两条：$d(\operatorname{tr}X)=\operatorname{tr}(dX)$ 与 $d(\det X)=\operatorname{tr}(\operatorname{adj}(X)\,dX)$（一般式，$X$ 是任意方阵）；当 $X$ 可逆时 $\operatorname{adj}(X)=\det(X)X^{-1}$，于是 $d(\det X)=\det(X)\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1}dX)$。

合成函数不必背新法则，用**先内后外**的链式流程：设 $Y=Y(X)$、$f=f(Y)$，先求内层微分 $dY$，再代入外层 $df=\operatorname{tr}\big((\partial f/\partial Y)^{\top}dY\big)$，最后把结果整理成 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$，$G$ 即 $\partial f/\partial X$。用向量化记号等价地有 $\partial f/\partial\operatorname{vec}(X)=\big(\partial\operatorname{vec}(Y)/\partial\operatorname{vec}(X)\big)^{\top}\partial f/\partial\operatorname{vec}(Y)$，两条路径给出的答案相同。
definitionEn:
Once shapes are settled, we need an **engine**. Matrix calculus does not recompute partial derivatives from scratch; instead it differentiates identities directly. Think of a matrix as the one-parameter family $X(t)=X_0+tB$ and of $d$ as the directional derivative at $t=0$: a linear operator that differentiates along an arbitrary direction $B$. It behaves well with addition, scalar multiplication, transposition and the trace, but with matrix products **the order can never be swapped** — that is the root of almost every mistake (the rules below act on the **differential** $d$ itself and are independent of any layout convention; when importing derivative or gradient formulas from other sources, check their layout first).

Basic rules: $d(X+Y)=dX+dY$, $d(kX)=k\,dX$ and $d(X^{\top})=(dX)^{\top}$; the product rule $d(XY)=(dX)Y+X(dY)$ (the two factors keep their positions); the inverse rule $d(X^{-1})=-X^{-1}(dX)X^{-1}$ (a minus sign, with $dX$ sandwiched between three factors, valid for invertible $X$); and the elementwise Hadamard rule $d(X\odot Y)=(dX)\odot Y+X\odot(dY)$. Scalar derivatives keep the batch-wide convention (the **denominator/gradient layout**): $\partial f/\partial X$ has the same shape as $X$ and $df=\operatorname{tr}((\partial f/\partial X)^{\top}dX)$.

Two rules carry most of the workload for scalar functions: $d(\operatorname{tr}X)=\operatorname{tr}(dX)$ and $d(\det X)=\operatorname{tr}(\operatorname{adj}(X)\,dX)$, which holds for every square matrix; when $X$ is invertible, $\operatorname{adj}(X)=\det(X)X^{-1}$ gives $d(\det X)=\det(X)\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1}dX)$.

Composite functions need no new rule if you work **inner first**: for $Y=Y(X)$ and $f=f(Y)$, compute the inner differential $dY$, substitute it into the outer differential $df=\operatorname{tr}\big((\partial f/\partial Y)^{\top}dY\big)$, and rearrange the result into $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$; then $G=\partial f/\partial X$. In vectorized notation this is $\partial f/\partial\operatorname{vec}(X)=\big(\partial\operatorname{vec}(Y)/\partial\operatorname{vec}(X)\big)^{\top}\partial f/\partial\operatorname{vec}(Y)$, and both routes agree.

formulas.note: 线性与转置：d 逐项作用在加法、数乘与转置上，是后面所有法则的基础。
formulas.noteEn: Linearity and transpose: d acts termwise on sums, scalar multiples and transposes; everything else builds on this.

formulas.note: 乘积法则：两个因子的左右顺序不能交换——矩阵乘法不满足交换律。
formulas.noteEn: Product rule: the two factors keep their left-right positions, since matrix multiplication does not commute.

formulas.note: 逆的微分：负号与三因子顺序都要记牢，由 XX⁻¹=I 两边微分得到。
formulas.noteEn: Inverse rule: remember both the minus sign and the order of the three factors; it follows by differentiating XX⁻¹=I.

formulas.note: 迹与行列式：一般式对任意方阵成立，含 X⁻¹ 的版本只对可逆矩阵成立。
formulas.noteEn: Trace and determinant: the general form holds for every square matrix, while the form containing X⁻¹ requires X to be invertible.

formulas.note: Hadamard（逐元素）乘积：逐元素看就是普通的标量乘积法则。
formulas.noteEn: Hadamard (elementwise) product: entry by entry it is just the usual scalar product rule.

properties: 顺序法则：矩阵乘法不交换，$d(XY)$ 的两项位置固定，$d(X^{-1})$ 必须是 $-X^{-1}(dX)X^{-1}$——写成 $-X^{-2}dX$ 或 $-(dX)X^{-2}$ 都是错的（形状虽然相同，数值/顺序不对）：必须三个因子夹着 $dX$。
线性与兼容：$d$ 与加法、数乘、转置、迹都可交换，所以任何由乘法与逆搭出的表达式都能逐层微分。
行列式：一般式 $d(\det X)=\operatorname{tr}(\operatorname{adj}(X)\,dX)$ 对任意方阵成立；只有写成 $\det(X)\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1}dX)$ 时才需要 $X$ 可逆。
链式法则：稳妥的用法是「先内后外」——先算内层 $dY$，再代入外层 $df$，最后凑成 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ 读出梯度；这避免了不同教材对矩阵链式法则的表述分歧。
检验习惯：任何新推出的 $dF$ 都可以用有限差分核对——比较 $(F(X+tB)-F(X))/t$ 与公式给出的方向导数，$t$ 足够小时两者应吻合。
propertiesEn: Order rule: matrix products do not commute. The two terms of $d(XY)$ keep their positions, and $d(X^{-1})$ must be written as $-X^{-1}(dX)X^{-1}$; forms such as $-X^{-2}dX$ are wrong (the shapes can coincide, but the order and the values are off): $dX$ has to sit between three factors.
Linearity: d commutes with addition, scalar multiplication, transposition and the trace, so every expression built from products and inverses can be differentiated layer by layer.

Determinant: the general rule $d(\det X)=\operatorname{tr}(\operatorname{adj}(X)\,dX)$ holds for every square matrix; only the version $\det(X)\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1}dX)$ requires $X$ to be invertible.

Chain rule: work “inner first” — compute the inner differential dY, substitute it into the outer df, then match $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ to read off the gradient; this avoids the notational disputes found across textbooks.
Testing habit: any new differential dF can be checked by finite differences — compare $(F(X+tB)-F(X))/t$ with the directional derivative predicted by the formula; for small t the two must agree.

examples.problem: 设 $X$ 为 $2\times2$ 可逆矩阵。用法则推导 $d(\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1}))$，即求 $\partial\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1})/\partial X$，并在 $X=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$ 处用有限差分核对。
examples.solution:
**推导**：$d(\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1}))=\operatorname{tr}(d(X^{-1}))=\operatorname{tr}(-X^{-1}(dX)X^{-1})=-\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1}X^{-1}\,dX)$（用了迹的轮换），对照 $df=\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ 得 $\partial\operatorname{tr}(X^{-1})/\partial X=-X^{-\top}X^{-\top}$。

**数值核对**：$X^{-1}=\begin{pmatrix}1&-1\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$（可验证 $XX^{-1}=I$），$X^{-1}X^{-1}=\begin{pmatrix}2&-3\\-3&5\end{pmatrix}$，故 $G=\begin{pmatrix}-2&3\\3&-5\end{pmatrix}$。

**有限差分**（把 $X$ 的第 $(i,j)$ 元加 $t$ 后对 $t$ 求导）：
· 第 $(1,1)$ 元：$\operatorname{tr}(X(t)^{-1})=\dfrac{3+t}{1+t}$，在 $t=0$ 处导数为 $-2=G_{11}$ ✓
· 第 $(1,2)$ 元：$\operatorname{tr}(X(t)^{-1})=\dfrac{3}{1-t}$，导数为 $3=G_{12}$ ✓
· 第 $(2,2)$ 元：$\operatorname{tr}(X(t)^{-1})=\dfrac{3+t}{1+2t}$，导数为 $-5=G_{22}$ ✓（$G$ 对称，第 $(2,1)$ 元同为 $3$）

examples.problem: 验证逆的微分公式：取 $X=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$、方向 $B=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\0&0\end{pmatrix}$，比较 $d(X^{-1})$ 与公式 $-X^{-1}B\,X^{-1}$。
examples.solution:
沿 $B$ 的矩阵族为 $X(t)=\begin{pmatrix}2&1+t\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$，其行列式 $\det X(t)=1-t$，故 $X(t)^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{1-t}\begin{pmatrix}1&-(1+t)\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$。在 $t=0$ 处逐项求导得 $\begin{pmatrix}1&-2\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$。

另一方面 $X^{-1}B=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\0&-1\end{pmatrix}$，$(X^{-1}B)X^{-1}=\begin{pmatrix}-1&2\\1&-2\end{pmatrix}$，取负得 $\begin{pmatrix}1&-2\\-1&2\end{pmatrix}$，与直接求导完全一致 ✓。

title: 常用矩阵梯度公式（迹技巧）
summary: 分母布局下的标准梯度表：线性型、二次型、迹型、行列式型与逆型公式，以及「展开微分—轮换凑迹—读出梯度」的三步法。
summaryEn: The standard gradient table under the denominator layout — linear, quadratic, trace, determinant and inverse forms — plus the expand-cycle-read trace method.
definition:
有了运算法则，真正的计算任务就是：把 $f$ 的微分整理成 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$（向量情形是 $(\nabla f)^{\top}dx$），再读出 $G$。几乎所有公式都能现推，但常用的一批值得记牢。本库统一用**分母布局**：$\partial f/\partial x$ 与 $x$ 同型、$\partial f/\partial X$ 与 $X$ 同型，恒有

$$df=(\partial f/\partial x)^{\top}dx=\operatorname{tr}\!\left((\partial f/\partial X)^{\top}dX\right).$$

**凑迹三步法**：第一步，展开 $df$（乘积法则、逆的微分、行列式与迹的法则）；第二步，用迹的轮换 $\operatorname{tr}(PQ)=\operatorname{tr}(QP)$（多因子时 $\operatorname{tr}(PQR)=\operatorname{tr}(RPQ)$）把 $dX$ 挪到迹的**末尾**；第三步，把系数写成「某个矩阵的转置」并对照 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ 读出 $G$。目标形永远是 $\operatorname{tr}(\text{系数矩阵}\cdot dX)$，读梯度时别忘了转置这一层。

两个最容易踩的坑。其一，**对称化**：$\partial(x^{\top}Ax)/\partial x=(A+A^{\top})x$ 对一般 $A$ 成立，只有当 $A=A^{\top}$ 时才等于 $2Ax$；迹二次型 $\partial\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}AX)/\partial X=(A+A^{\top})X$ 同理。其二，**可逆条件**：$\partial\det(X)/\partial X$ 与 $\partial\ln\det(X)/\partial X$ 的简洁形式都要求 $X$ 可逆，而且都是**无约束**（全矩阵空间）版本——把 $X$ 限制在对称矩阵上会改变切空间，公式不能再照搬。文献中的同类结果若按其他布局给出，需先核对约定（标量公式常与本库互为转置）。
definitionEn:
With the rules in hand, the actual task is to rearrange the differential of $f$ into the form $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ — or $(\nabla f)^{\top}dx$ in the vector case — and read off $G$. Every identity can be re-derived in a line or two, but the standard list is worth memorizing. This library uses the **denominator layout** throughout: $\partial f/\partial x$ matches the shape of $x$ and $\partial f/\partial X$ matches the shape of $X$, so that

$$df=(\partial f/\partial x)^{\top}dx=\operatorname{tr}\!\left((\partial f/\partial X)^{\top}dX\right).$$

**The three-step trace method**: expand $df$ (product rule, inverse rule, determinant and trace rules); use the cyclic property $\operatorname{tr}(PQ)=\operatorname{tr}(QP)$ — and $\operatorname{tr}(PQR)=\operatorname{tr}(RPQ)$ for several factors — to move $dX$ to the **end** of the trace; then interpret the coefficient as a transpose and match $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ to read off $G$. The target form is always $\operatorname{tr}(\text{coefficient matrix}\cdot dX)$, and the transpose must not be dropped when reading the gradient.

Two classic traps. First, **symmetrization**: $\partial(x^{\top}Ax)/\partial x=(A+A^{\top})x$ for general $A$, reducing to $2Ax$ only when $A$ is symmetric; the same holds for $\partial\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}AX)/\partial X=(A+A^{\top})X$. Second, **invertibility**: the compact forms of $\partial\det(X)/\partial X$ and $\partial\ln\det(X)/\partial X$ require $X$ to be invertible, and both are **unconstrained** (full matrix space) versions — restricting $X$ to symmetric matrices changes the tangent space, so they cannot be copied over. Comparable results in the literature may use a different layout; check the convention before importing them (scalar formulas are often transposes of ours).

formulas.note: 线性型与范数：aᵀx 的梯度是 a，线性映射 Ax 的雅可比是 A，‖x‖² 的梯度是 2x（a 与 2x 都与 x 同型；A 是 m×n 的雅可比矩阵，一般与 x 不同型）。
formulas.noteEn: Linear forms and norms: the gradient of aᵀx is a, the Jacobian of Ax is A, and the gradient of ‖x‖² is 2x (a and 2x share the shape of x; A is an m×n Jacobian and generally has a different shape).

formulas.note: 二次型：一般 A 必须先对称化；只有 A 对称时才简写成 2Ax——这是最常见的出错点。
formulas.noteEn: Quadratic form: for general A the answer must be symmetrized; only symmetric A allows the shorthand 2Ax — the most common source of errors.

formulas.note: 迹的线性型：系数矩阵要转置；tr(X) 的梯度是单位阵（有些文献记作 E）。
formulas.noteEn: Linear trace forms: the coefficient matrix gets transposed; the gradient of tr(X) is the identity matrix (some texts write E for it).

formulas.note: 迹二次型与双线性型：前者得到对称化后的 (A+Aᵀ)X；后者是列乘行的外积 abᵀ。
formulas.noteEn: Trace-quadratic and bilinear forms: the first gives the symmetrized (A+Aᵀ)X, the second gives the outer product abᵀ.

formulas.note: 行列式与逆（X 可逆）：前两条是无约束情形的公式；最后一条由逆的微分法则直接得到。
formulas.noteEn: Determinant and inverse (X invertible): the first two are the unconstrained versions, and the last one follows directly from the inverse rule.

properties: 上表全部分式在分母布局下成立，且都能用 $df=(\partial f/\partial x)^{\top}dx$ 或 $df=\operatorname{tr}((\partial f/\partial X)^{\top}dX)$ 在一两步内验证。
对称化是二次型公式的灵魂：一般写法是 $(A+A^{\top})x$ 与 $(A+A^{\top})X$，只有 $A$ 对称时才退化为 $2Ax$、$2AX$。
迹的轮换 $\operatorname{tr}(PQR)=\operatorname{tr}(RPQ)$ 是推导主力：它把 $dX$ 挪到迹的末尾，从而直接读出梯度。
$\partial\det(X)/\partial X=\det(X)X^{-\top}$ 与 $\partial\ln\det(X)/\partial X=X^{-\top}$ 要求 $X$ 可逆，且是无约束版本；把 $X$ 限制在对称矩阵上时切空间改变，不能照搬。
数值检验：任取 $X$ 与方向 $B$，比较 $(f(X+tB)-f(X))/t$ 与 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}B)$，$t$ 足够小时两者吻合。
propertiesEn: Every identity above holds in the denominator layout, and each can be verified in one or two lines from $df=(\partial f/\partial x)^{\top}dx$ or $df=\operatorname{tr}((\partial f/\partial X)^{\top}dX)$.
Symmetrization is the heart of the quadratic-form formulas: the general answers are $(A+A^{\top})x$ and $(A+A^{\top})X$, collapsing to $2Ax$ and $2AX$ only for symmetric A.
The cyclic property $\operatorname{tr}(PQR)=\operatorname{tr}(RPQ)$ is the workhorse: it moves dX to the end of the trace so the gradient can be read off directly.

The formulas $\partial\det(X)/\partial X=\det(X)X^{-\top}$ and $\partial\ln\det(X)/\partial X=X^{-\top}$ require X to be invertible and are unconstrained versions; restricting X to symmetric matrices changes the tangent space, so they cannot be copied over.
Numerical check: for any X and direction B, compare $(f(X+tB)-f(X))/t$ with $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}B)$; for small t the two agree.

examples.problem: 推导 $\partial\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}AX)/\partial X$，并用有限差分在 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\0&3\end{pmatrix}$、$X=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 处核对。
examples.solution:
**推导**：$d\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}AX)=\operatorname{tr}((dX)^{\top}AX)+\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}A\,dX)=\operatorname{tr}((AX)^{\top}dX)+\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}A\,dX)=\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}(A^{\top}+A)dX)=\operatorname{tr}\big(((A+A^{\top})X)^{\top}dX\big)$，故梯度 $G=(A+A^{\top})X$（这里用到了 $\operatorname{tr}((dX)^{\top}AX)=\operatorname{tr}((AX)^{\top}dX)$）。

**数值**：$A+A^{\top}=\begin{pmatrix}2&2\\2&6\end{pmatrix}$，$G=(A+A^{\top})X=\begin{pmatrix}2&4\\2&8\end{pmatrix}$，且 $\operatorname{tr}(X^{\top}AX)=7$。

**有限差分**（把 $X$ 的第 $(i,j)$ 元加 $t$，读一次项系数）：$(1,1)$ 元得 $7+2t+t^2$，$(1,2)$ 元得 $7+4t+t^2$，$(2,1)$ 元得 $7+2t+3t^2$，$(2,2)$ 元得 $7+8t+3t^2$，对应 $2,4,2,8$，与 $G$ 完全一致 ✓。

examples.problem: 用凑迹法推导 $\partial(a^{\top}Xb)/\partial X$ 与 $\partial\operatorname{tr}(AX)/\partial X$，并对前者取 $a=(1,2)^{\top}$、$b=(3,1)^{\top}$、$X=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ 做有限差分核对。
examples.solution:
**外积公式**：$d(a^{\top}Xb)=a^{\top}(dX)b=\operatorname{tr}(a^{\top}(dX)b)=\operatorname{tr}(ba^{\top}dX)=\operatorname{tr}\big((ab^{\top})^{\top}dX\big)$，故 $\partial(a^{\top}Xb)/\partial X=ab^{\top}$。

**迹公式**：$d\operatorname{tr}(AX)=\operatorname{tr}(A\,dX)$，对照 $\operatorname{tr}(G^{\top}dX)$ 得 $G=A^{\top}$。

**数值核对**：$ab^{\top}=\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\6&2\end{pmatrix}$，$f(X)=a^{\top}Xb=6$；分别把四个元素加 $t$，得 $f=6+3t$、$6+t$、$6+6t$、$6+2t$，一次项系数 $3,1,6,2$ 正是 $ab^{\top}$ 的四个元素 ✓。

title: 矩阵微分与最优化
summary: 用矩阵微分整块地写出一阶与二阶最优性条件、二次型极值公式和最小二乘的正规方程，并厘清正定与半正定的细微差别。
summaryEn: First- and second-order optimality conditions, quadratic-form minimizers and the least-squares normal equations in matrix form, with the subtlety of positive semidefiniteness spelled out.
definition:
矩阵微分的第一个大应用是最优化：写出 $\nabla f=0$ 求驻点，再看二阶条件。与多元微积分相比，「增量」在求导技术上：以前逐个算偏导，现在用 $d$ 与迹整块地算梯度与 Hessian。标量导数沿用全批统一约定（**分母/梯度布局**）：$\nabla f=\partial f/\partial x$ 与 $x$ 同型（文献中常按分子布局写成行向量，与本库互为转置，套公式前先核对约定）。

**一阶条件**：$f$ 可微时，局部极值点 $x^{*}$ 必须满足 $\nabla f(x^{*})=0$。**二阶条件**：Hessian $H(x)=\partial^{2}f/\partial x\,\partial x^{\top}$ 的第 $(i,j)$ 元是 $\partial^{2}f/\partial x_i\partial x_j$，在二阶偏导连续时**对称**。于是：$H(x^{*})$ 正定 $\Rightarrow$ $x^{*}$ 是严格局部极小点；$H(x^{*})$ 负定 $\Rightarrow$ 严格局部极大点；$H(x^{*})$ 不定（特征值有正有负）$\Rightarrow$ 鞍点。注意正定给出的是**充分不必要**条件：$H$ 半正定甚至 $H=0$ 时也可能是严格极小，例如 $f(x)=x^4$ 在 $x=0$ 处 $H=0$，但 $0$ 依然是严格极小点——这种情形要靠更高阶项判定。

最常用的两个模型。**无约束二次型**：$f(x)=x^{\top}Ax-b^{\top}x$（取 $A=A^{\top}$）满足 $\nabla f=2Ax-b$、$H=2A$；当 $A$ 正定时有唯一极小点 $x^{*}=\frac{1}{2}A^{-1}b$。**最小二乘**：$f(x)=\|Ax-b\|^{2}$ 有 $\nabla f=2A^{\top}(Ax-b)$，令梯度为零即得**正规方程** $A^{\top}Ax=A^{\top}b$；$A$ 列满秩时 $x^{*}=(A^{\top}A)^{-1}A^{\top}b$，秩亏时解不唯一，用广义逆取最小范数解 $A^{+}b$。

两个方向的一句话延拓：数值上用**梯度下降** $x\leftarrow x-\eta\nabla f(x)$ 迭代；带约束时用**拉格朗日乘数法**把约束的梯度并入一阶条件。
definitionEn:
The first big application of matrix calculus is optimization: solve $\nabla f=0$ for stationary points and then apply second-order conditions. Compared with multivariable calculus the upgrade is technical — instead of computing partial derivatives one by one, the differential and the trace deliver the gradient and the Hessian in one block. Scalar derivatives keep the batch-wide **denominator (gradient) layout**, so $\nabla f=\partial f/\partial x$ has the shape of $x$ (much of the literature writes the gradient as a row vector, the transpose of ours; check the convention before plugging in a formula).

**First-order condition**: if $f$ is differentiable, a local extremum $x^{*}$ must satisfy $\nabla f(x^{*})=0$. **Second-order conditions**: the Hessian $H(x)=\partial^{2}f/\partial x\,\partial x^{\top}$ has $(i,j)$ entry $\partial^{2}f/\partial x_i\partial x_j$ and is **symmetric** whenever the second partials are continuous. Hence: $H(x^{*})$ positive definite $\Rightarrow$ strict local minimum; $H(x^{*})$ negative definite $\Rightarrow$ strict local maximum; $H(x^{*})$ indefinite (eigenvalues of both signs) $\Rightarrow$ saddle point. Positive definiteness is **sufficient, not necessary**: a positive semidefinite Hessian — even $H=0$ — may still give a strict minimum, as $f(x)=x^4$ does at $x=0$, where the decision needs higher-order terms.

Two workhorse models. **Unconstrained quadratic form**: $f(x)=x^{\top}Ax-b^{\top}x$ with $A=A^{\top}$ has $\nabla f=2Ax-b$ and $H=2A$; if $A$ is positive definite the unique minimizer is $x^{*}=\frac{1}{2}A^{-1}b$. **Least squares**: $f(x)=\|Ax-b\|^{2}$ has $\nabla f=2A^{\top}(Ax-b)$, and setting it to zero gives the **normal equations** $A^{\top}Ax=A^{\top}b$; when $A$ has full column rank, $x^{*}=(A^{\top}A)^{-1}A^{\top}b$, while in the rank-deficient case the solutions form a set and the pseudoinverse selects the least-norm one, $A^{+}b$.

Two one-line extensions: numerically, **gradient descent** iterates $x\leftarrow x-\eta\nabla f(x)$; with constraints, the **method of Lagrange multipliers** folds the constraint gradients into the first-order condition.

formulas.note: 一阶必要条件与 Hessian 的定义；分母布局下 H 的第 (i,j) 元是 ∂²f/∂xᵢ∂xⱼ。
formulas.noteEn: The first-order necessary condition and the definition of the Hessian; in the denominator layout its (i,j) entry is ∂²f/∂xᵢ∂xⱼ.

formulas.latex: H(x^{*})\succ0\Rightarrow\text{严格极小},\qquad H(x^{*})\prec0\Rightarrow\text{严格极大},\qquad H\ \text{不定}\Rightarrow\text{鞍点}
formulas.note: 正定只是严格极小的充分条件，不是必要条件；H 半正定也可能给出严格极小（如 x⁴）。
formulas.noteEn: Positive definiteness is only sufficient for a strict minimum, never necessary; a positive semidefinite Hessian may also give a strict minimum (e.g. x⁴).

formulas.note: 二次型的完整解：梯度、Hessian 与正定时的唯一极小点都是整块公式。
formulas.noteEn: The complete quadratic-form solution: gradient, Hessian and, for positive definite A, the unique minimizer — all in closed form.

formulas.note: 最小二乘：梯度里的 2 与 Aᵀ 位置都不能错；令梯度为零即得正规方程。
formulas.noteEn: Least squares: neither the factor 2 nor the position of Aᵀ in the gradient may be misplaced; setting it to zero yields the normal equations.

formulas.note: 梯度下降：沿负梯度方向走一步，步长 η 需要适当选取。
formulas.noteEn: Gradient descent: one step along the negative gradient, with the step size η chosen appropriately.

properties: Hessian 对称（二阶偏导连续时混合偏导可交换），所以二阶条件只看 $H$ 的特征值符号；沿单位特征向量 $v$ 的方向，$f$ 的局部曲率恰为 $v^{\top}Hv=\lambda$。
正定 $\Rightarrow$ 严格极小是**充分不必要**；$H$ 半正定也可能给出严格极小（$f(x)=x^4$ 在 $0$ 处 $H=0$），需要更高阶项才能判定。
二次型求导前先对称化：$\nabla(x^{\top}Ax)=(A+A^{\top})x$；本节的二次型公式默认 $A=A^{\top}$，此时才写成 $2Ax$。
最小二乘的几何：最优残差 $r=b-Ax^{*}$ 与 $A$ 的列空间正交（$A^{\top}r=0$），$Ax^{*}$ 就是 $b$ 在列空间上的正交投影；$A$ 列满秩时解唯一，秩亏时用广义逆取最小范数解。
迭代法（梯度下降）只用到一阶信息：步长过大会发散，收敛慢时可用牛顿法方向 $-H^{-1}\nabla f$ 加速（代价是计算并求逆 $H$）。
propertiesEn: The Hessian is symmetric (mixed partials commute when the second derivatives are continuous), so the second-order test depends only on the signs of its eigenvalues; along a unit eigenvector v the local curvature of f equals $v^{\top}Hv=\lambda$.

Positive definiteness is sufficient but not necessary for a strict minimum; a positive semidefinite Hessian may also give a strict minimum ($f(x)=x^4$ at 0, where H = 0), and higher-order terms are then needed.
Symmetrize before differentiating a quadratic form: $\nabla(x^{\top}Ax)=(A+A^{\top})x$; the formulas here assume $A=A^{\top}$, in which case $2Ax$ is correct.

Least squares has a geometric meaning: the optimal residual $r=b-Ax^{*}$ is orthogonal to the column space of A ($A^{\top}r=0$), so $Ax^{*}$ is the orthogonal projection of b; the solution is unique for full column rank, and the pseudoinverse selects the least-norm solution in the rank-deficient case.

Gradient descent uses only first-order information: too large a step diverges, and slow convergence can be accelerated by the Newton direction $-H^{-1}\nabla f$, at the cost of forming and inverting H.

examples.problem: 取 $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&2\\1&3\end{pmatrix}$、$b=(3,1,5)^{\top}$，最小化 $f(x)=\|Ax-b\|^{2}$：写出 $\nabla f$ 与正规方程，解出 $x^{*}$ 并验证它确实最优。
examples.solution:
**梯度**：展开得 $f(x)=x^{\top}A^{\top}Ax-2b^{\top}Ax+b^{\top}b$，由二次型公式 $\nabla f=2A^{\top}Ax-2A^{\top}b=2A^{\top}(Ax-b)$。

**正规方程**：$A^{\top}A=\begin{pmatrix}3&6\\6&14\end{pmatrix}$，$A^{\top}b=(9,20)^{\top}$，即 $\begin{cases}3x_1+6x_2=9\\6x_1+14x_2=20\end{cases}$；$\det(A^{\top}A)=6$，解得 $x^{*}=(1,1)^{\top}$（代回两个方程都成立 ✓）。

**验证最优性**：$Ax^{*}=(2,3,4)^{\top}$，残差 $r=b-Ax^{*}=(1,-2,1)^{\top}$，而 $A^{\top}r=(0,0)^{\top}$，即残差与 $A$ 的两列都正交，于是 $\nabla f(x^{*})=0$ ✓。此时 $f(x^{*})=1+4+1=6$；对比 $x=(0,0)^{\top}$ 时 $f=35$、$x=(2,1)^{\top}$ 时 $f=0+9+0=9$，都更大 ✓。

examples.problem: 设 $f(x)=x^{\top}Ax-b^{\top}x$，其中 $A=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$、$b=(6,6)^{\top}$。求驻点并判断类型。
examples.solution: $\nabla f=2Ax-b=(4x_1+2x_2-6,\;2x_1+4x_2-6)^{\top}$，令 $\nabla f=0$ 得 $x^{*}=(1,1)^{\top}$。Hessian $H=2A=\begin{pmatrix}4&2\\2&4\end{pmatrix}$ 的顺序主子式为 $4>0$ 与 $16-4=12>0$，故 $A$ 正定（$H$ 的特征值为 $2,6$），$x^{*}$ 是严格极小点。函数值 $f(x^{*})=x^{*\top}Ax^{*}-b^{\top}x^{*}=6-12=-6$。
